statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The patient has established atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring (CPT 93247) was ordered
The claim was denied with reason code CO-197
The service was denied because required precertification or authorization was not obtained prior to the date of service
The SilverBridge Advantage plan terms mandate precertification or authorization for this procedure
